name: Alpha midline sine at IAF (sTMS timing)
origin: NeoSync synchronized TMS (sTMS): Leuchter, Cook et al. (UCLA and a multisite trial); the 3-coil mapping is a project construct
summary: Copies the timing of NeoSync's synchronized TMS (sTMS): a sine at the individual alpha frequency (10 Hz by default) for 30 min over three midline sites, Fpz, Fz and Cz, with neighbouring coils in antiphase. The device's rotating magnets measured about 0.64 T at their surface, some 100,000 times this helmet's 5 uT, so this is a pattern replica, not the tested device.
notes: sTMS spun three diametrically magnetised NdFeB magnets (about 0.64 T, 6,400 G, at the surface) at the person's individual alpha frequency (IAF, 8-13 Hz, from a brief eyes-closed EEG) over the frontopolar region just above the nasion, the frontocentral region (superior frontal gyrus) and the central region; Fpz, Fz and Cz are this project's mapping, and the pilot (Jin & Phillips 2014) calls the third magnet parietal, about 9 cm behind the second, so it may sit a little further back than Cz. Jin & Phillips state that the magnets rotate 180 degrees out of phase with each other; this program reads that as neighbours in antiphase, so Fz plays an inverted copy of the Fpz/Cz sine (a 200-point table locked to the same 10 Hz). A rotating magnet turns its field direction, while each coil only pulses along its own axis, so only the frequency, sites, duration and phase relation are copied. To use your own IAF, take N = 2000 / IAF rounded to a whole number, set f0 of track 1 to 2000 / N Hz and replace the table with N points of round(128 - 127 sin(2 pi i / N)) at 0.5 ms; the inverted copy only stays locked when the table holds a whole number of 0.5-ms points per cycle. At 5 uT the induced electric field is about 1e-6 V/m at 10 Hz, orders of magnitude below fields shown to affect neurons. In the pivotal trial (Leuchter 2015) sTMS did not beat sham in the intent-to-treat analysis (n = 202) and did so only per protocol (n = 120), with NeoSync co-authors; Cook 2019 reports midline alpha changes that tracked improvement on active treatment only. This program is not a treatment for depression or anything else; anyone with depression should see a clinician. Not for people with epilepsy; stop on discomfort.
setting: Lying face-up, as in the trial (head under the device's treatment arm), in a quiet room. The trial measured the IAF from a brief resting eyes-closed EEG before treatment; without one, keep the 10 Hz default.
schedule: Trial schedule: one 30-min session a day, 5 days a week for 6 weeks (30 sessions); the device locked out for 10 h after each session.
source: Leuchter et al. 2015, Brain Stimul https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26143022/ ; NCT03288714 study protocol (device, magnet sites, 30-min sessions, 10-h lockout) https://cdn.clinicaltrials.gov/large-docs/14/NCT03288714/Prot_000.pdf ; Cook et al. 2019, Neuromodulation https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30637862/ ; Jin & Phillips 2014, sTMS pilot study (magnets rotate 180 degrees out of phase)

phases.name: IAF sine (10 Hz), Fz in antiphase
